title: The Big Match
intro: 五段都和比赛有关，每段都有转折：本来要守门但受伤了、本来在本校比但场地太湿、以为输了其实赢了、游泳赛推迟、电视没转播改听广播。再听一段杯赛通知，五个空五种类型。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: I was going to be in goal for the school team on Saturday. I've practised all month.
But yesterday I fell off my bike and hurt my hand, so I can't play. I'll go and watch, and take photos for the school website.

questions.q: What is the boy going to do on Saturday?
questions.explain: was going to be in goal… But… hurt my hand, so I can't play. I'll go and watch——转折后是去看。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: Team, listen. Saturday's match was going to be here at our school, but it rained all week and our field is too wet.
So we're playing at Park School. The bus leaves from here at one o'clock, same day, same time.

questions.q: What is the woman telling the team?
options: The match is in a different place.
The match is on a different day.
There is no match on Saturday.
questions.explain: was going to be here… but… too wet. So we're playing at Park School——换了地方。same day, same time 说明日子没变，比赛照打。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: Kate, how was the match? You look tired.
They had two goals and we had none at half time, and I thought we were going to lose.
Oh no. So you lost?
No! We scored three goals in the last ten minutes, so we won three-two. Everyone was jumping!

questions.q: What is Kate saying about the match?
options: Her team won at the end.
questions.explain: I thought we were going to lose 是中场的想法，转折在 No! We scored three goals… we won three-two。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: A message for everyone in the children's swimming race. The race was going to start at ten.
But the pool is being cleaned, so it will now start at eleven. Same pool, same race, just one hour later. Sorry about that.

questions.q: What is the man telling the swimmers?
options: The race is in a different pool.
questions.explain: was going to start at ten. But… will now start at eleven——推迟了一小时。same pool 说明泳池没换，长度没提。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: Ben, are you coming to mine to watch the big match on TV tonight?
I wanted to, but my dad says it's not on TV, only on the radio.
Really? Then let's listen to it on the radio in my room. It's better than nothing.
OK, I'll bring some biscuits. See you at seven.

questions.q: How will the boys follow the match?
questions.explain: wanted to (watch on TV), but… not on TV, only on the radio. Then let's listen to it on the radio——转折后改听广播。

sections.intro: 听一段体育中心的杯赛通知，把笔记补全。五个空五种类型：地名拼读、数字、时间、价格、电话。

script.text: Hello, everyone. Here is some news about this year's football cup for schools.
It's called the Barton Cup, that's B-A-R-T-O-N, because it's played at Barton Sports Centre.
Last year there were eight teams, but this year there are twelve teams, so it's a big day.
The gates open at half past eight, and the first match starts at quarter past nine. The last match is at four.
Tickets are five pounds for adults and two pounds fifty for children, and children under five come in free.
For tickets, call the sports centre on five five four, three one seven oh. That's five five four, three one seven oh. See you there!

questions.explain: the Barton Cup, that's B-A-R-T-O-N，照拼读写。
this year there are twelve teams = 12。eight 是去年的。
the first match starts at quarter past nine = 9:15。half past eight 是开门时间，four 是最后一场。
two pounds fifty for children = £2.50。five pounds 是成人票。
five five four, three one seven oh = 554 3170。号码会重复一遍。
